name: Visualping
whyPeoplePay: Visualping sells page change detection without a server: screenshots, schedules, and alerts when a price, job listing or paragraph moves, billed by checks so the invoice scales with how many pages you watch.

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: Entry paid tier; exact check quotas move. Confirm on the vendor pricing page.

pricing.note: Visualping tiers and check limits change. Treat $10 Starter as indicative and re-read the page before quoting savings.

ranked.rationale: Self-hosted page watches with notifications you wire yourself. One container to start; add a heavier browser fetcher only when JavaScript pages demand it.
